app.name: Money Tracker
app.style: Classic, calm personal-finance interface: neutral grouped surfaces, one brand-colored hero, plain language
designGoals: A first-time user can record an expense without instructions
The most important number (total balance) is seen first
Every feature is reachable from a visible place (Home or Settings)
Readable type, 48 dp touch targets, correct in light and dark modes
principles: Inset grouped lists (iOS Settings / Google Wallet) for related rows
Single high-emphasis surface per screen; everything else neutral
Frequency-based prominence: Expense and Income get the biggest targets
Color carries meaning only: green = money in, red = overdue/negative, amber = owed, blue = transfer/brand
No gradients, glows, uppercase eyebrows or decorative emoji

designTokens.money: Currency symbol + thousands separators, e.g. Rs 12,345.00, $1,200.00, −Rs 500.00; signed (+/−) in activity lists

navigation.type: Material 3 NavigationBar with hairline top border

sharedComponents.SectionHeader: titleMedium label above a group, optional text action on the right
sharedComponents.GroupedCard: White card, 16 radius, hairline border, rows separated by dividers inset to the text
sharedComponents.AppTile: IconBadge + title/subtitle + trailing + chevron, min height 60
sharedComponents.IconBadge: 40 dp rounded-square tinted container with icon
sharedComponents.FormRow: Form row 'icon  Label ........ value >' that opens a picker
sharedComponents.FormTextRow: Borderless text input row inside a GroupedCard
sharedComponents.AmountField: Large centered amount input with currency symbol
sharedComponents.ActivityTile: Activity row: category icon, title, subtitle, signed amount, Pending pill
sharedComponents.showPickerSheet: Bottom-sheet single choice list with check mark
sharedComponents.SheetScaffold: Editor sheet: title, fields, error, full-width Save, optional neutral and destructive actions
sharedComponents.BottomActionBar: Pinned primary button that rises above the keyboard
sharedComponents.EmptyState / ErrorBanner / InfoNote: Friendly empty, error and helper messaging
sharedComponents.CategoryBadge: Category icon in a rounded square tinted with the category's color (user-chosen, or a stable automatic swatch); adjusted for readability in light/dark

screens.splash: Brand mark, name, tagline, small spinner; friendly retry on error; fades into the shell
home: Balance card (only colored surface): Total balance, account count, net this month
Welcome card with 'Add your first entry' when there is no activity
This month: Income | Spent stat cards
Money owed: Owed to you | You owe cards → Money owed
screens.addMenu: Bottom sheet 'What would you like to add?': large Expense / Income cards, then Transfer, Someone owes me, I owe someone, Tax payment
screens.transactionForm: Type chips (new only) → big amount → [Category, Account, Date, Due date] → [Tax paid (income/expense only, amount + 'tax paid' suffix)] → [Person, Note] → tax summary note ('Rs 1,170.00 leaves Cash…') → pinned Save. Delete icon when editing. Also edits standalone tax payments
screens.transferForm: Big amount → From/To with swap button → Date + Note → explanation → pinned Transfer. Edit mode: 'Edit transfer', Save, delete icon
screens.history: Search (name, note, account or amount) → Filters chip with count badge + type chips (All, Expenses, Income, Transfers, Owed, Tax) → active filter chips (account, category, dates; × to clear) → result card (N entries · In · Out) → groups by day with daily net. Filter sheet: Account, Category (includes subcategories), Date (Any time, This month, Last month, Last 3 months, This year, Custom dates). Every row opens its editor
screens.reports: Period segments (Month, 6 months, Year, Custom) → ‹ range › bar (custom: Change dates) → Net for this period with income/expense/tax bar and entry count → Month by month bar chart (multi-month periods) → Spending / Income by category rolled up to parent with subcategory lines (tap → filtered History) → Tax paid (total, % of income, by account) → Accounts (in, out, net; tap → account page) → Money owed (lent out, borrowed, received back, paid back) → Where you stand today + Net worth
screens.settings: Preferences (Currency, Defaults for new entries, Appearance) → Manage (Accounts, Categories, Money owed, Assets) → Data (Import and export) → About
screens.accounts: Total card, Active and Archived groups; tap → account page
screens.assets: Total value card, assets with gain/loss; sheet (name, price paid, worth today, bought on, notes, delete)
screens.categories: Expenses / Income / Both sections, indented tree with colored category badges; sheet: live badge preview + name, used-for segmented, Icon (grouped icon grid, or Automatic), Color (any color: saturation/brightness panel, hue slider, hex input, quick swatches; stored as #RRGGBB), Inside parent picker, delete
screens.owe: Owed to you / You owe sections with totals; overdue in red; tap → Mark as received/paid sheet with account choice and Edit details
screens.accountDetail: Balance card (type, archived pill, starting balance) → This month Money in / Money out → Activity grouped by day with transfers shown ± for this account → Search opens History filtered to the account. Edit icon opens the account sheet (name, Cash/Bank, starting balance, archive, delete)
screens.importExport: Settings › Data › Import and export: Export to Excel (Month / 6 months / Year / Custom, ‹ range ›, entry count, Export button → save dialog), column list note; Import from Excel (explanation, Choose Excel file, Save a blank template); Last import card (Imported, Skipped as duplicates, Problems + row messages)

interactionRules: Saving from the Add flow shows a 'Saved' snackbar
Destructive actions always confirm in a dialog with a red Delete
Pickers are bottom sheets; editors are bottom sheets; full forms are pushed pages
A single non-archived account is preselected on new entries
Amount fields accept digits and up to 2 decimals only
Archived accounts are hidden from pickers but kept in history
Tax entered on an income or expense is paid from the same account on the same date and deleted with it
Every History row (transaction, tax, transfer) opens an editor with delete
Report periods can't step past the current one
Categories are colorful everywhere they appear: lists, pickers, history rows and report bars use the category's color
